place._who: Jessica's proposed pickup guard, as the built field (ELIZA 2026-10-15): spacers round the crate when he first comes within 250 m, after the accept. Overtime's Spacer gang list (9 entries).

second._remote: On a board the second place is always a request (ELIZA 2026-10-15). It had a same-planet guard (his 10-15 pick) and that guard CRASHED the game at startquest (his play, 2026-10-19); his ruling: no planet guards, 'it's fine if the mission is on the same planet'. So the drop lands wherever the request puts it.

place._theme: A wreck here; the delivery site must never be a wreck itself (two places that could draw one POI warn). ELIZA 2026-10-15, measured: a request can put down 3 wreck sites of 214, so every crash site is one of three; the board places it, so it always starts.
